{{ety|en|id=adjective|:inh|enm:satisfyed<ety:from<satisfien>>|:afeq|satisfy|-ed<id:adjective>}}
From {{inh|en|enm|satisfyed}}, {{m|enm|i-satisfyed}}, {{m|enm|i-satisfied}}, past participle of {{der|en|enm|satisfien}}, equivalent to {{af|en|satisfy|-ed}}.

====Adjective====
{{en-adj}}

# In a state of [[satisfaction]].
#: {{syn|en|content|happy|pleased}}
#: {{ux|en|I'm '''satisfied''' with your progress in your homework, so you can watch television now.}}
# Convinced based on the available evidence.
#: {{ux|en|The judge was '''satisfied''' that the defendant did not go out with the intent to start a riot.}}
